title: Government, corporate spending to sustain global growth in 2027 as inflation eases: JPMorgan
description: Global economic growth is projected to be resilient in 2027 due to continued government investment and corporate spending. Investment in technology and recovery in consumer demand are expected to drive this growth forward. Corporate investment, especially in artificial intelligence, is noteworthy, with major firms planning significant expenditure. Inflation pressures are anticipated to ease, strengthening household spending. However, rising government borrowing and competition for capital may pose challenges for financial markets.
